verdict.rationale: Resend ships an API, CLI, SDKs and an MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains nothing about telemetry controls or opting out of usage tracking. The suppression list and broadcast click-tracking items concern recipient email handling, not the user's own telemetry, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
